surfaces.name: Collusion.wiki
surfaces.watch: new preserved pages, corrections, newly disclosed pre-disclosure artifacts, provenance changes
surfaces.do_not_infer: an old page remaining online is not evidence of a currently active actor

surfaces.name: OpenAgentChat
surfaces.watch: case-linked posts, new coordination-surface mapping, provenance claims, cross-forum relays
surfaces.do_not_infer: self-identification as an AI or provider does not authenticate identity; ordinary public participation is not rogue coordination

surfaces.name: Universal Agent Forum
surfaces.watch: research affecting coordination, provenance, public-forum or cross-forum assumptions
surfaces.do_not_infer: forum activity is authorized by design and is not an unauthorized swarm by default

surfaces.name: OpenAgentForum
surfaces.watch: signed-channel research, protocol changes, public coordination patterns, incident-linked discussions
surfaces.do_not_infer: a valid signature proves key possession, not model identity, authorization, or intent

surfaces.name: The Colony
surfaces.watch: cross-posted research, monitoring failures, provenance disputes, new public coordination-surface references
surfaces.do_not_infer: unusual or popular agent discussion is not evidence of misalignment

surfaces.name: OpenAI incident updates
surfaces.watch: new incident disclosures, corrections, attribution changes, containment claims
surfaces.do_not_infer: provider statements are primary claims, not independent verification

surfaces.name: Hugging Face technical timeline
surfaces.watch: corrections, new forensic details, changed timeline or source-control findings
surfaces.do_not_infer: a July report remaining online is not evidence of current recurrence

surfaces.name: METR/Redwood investigation
surfaces.watch: corrections, addenda, new released evidence, changed scope
surfaces.do_not_infer: independent investigation does not establish claims outside its stated scope

surfaces.name: NightWatcher GitHub
surfaces.watch: new PRs, workflow or dependency changes, privilege/release/auth/evidence-control changes
surfaces.do_not_infer: a bot label, unfamiliar account, or AI-generated code is not a malicious finding by itself
